title: Teaching Faculty, Senior Resident and More
application_fee: Rs. 500/- as Interview Fee, if applicable
summary: ESIC Medical College & Hospital Varanasi has announced a recruitment drive for 79 vacancies including Teaching Faculty and Senior Resident posts on a contract basis. Interested candidates meeting the medical qualifications can apply by submitting the required application form and documents before the deadline.
eligibility_bullets: Must possess relevant medical qualifications such as MBBS, MD, MS, DNB, PG Diploma, BDS, MDS, or DM as applicable to the post.
Must be registered with the NMC, State Medical Council, Dental Council of India, or State Dental Council.
Experience as per the notified post requirements in a government or private hospital/institution.

vacancy_breakdown.category: Teaching Faculty, Senior Resident and More

how_to_apply_steps: Carefully read the detailed advertisement and ensure you have an active e-mail ID and mobile number.
Download the application form and fill it completely in capital letters by hand.
Attach a color photograph containing full face, both ears, and neck in frontal view, and sign across it.
Enclose self-attested copies of required educational certificates, mark sheets, medical registration, experience certificates, and a Demand Draft of Rs. 500/- if applicable.
Submit the completed application form along with the checklist of documents to the designated authority before the last date.
